scope: Extend the AC1024 rooted associative-graph whole-file transaction profile to eight ordered inline constraint-node shapes, including a rigid-set payload, and four distinct non-null geometry-dependency links.

source.profile: NOD ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK -> association DICTIONARY -> NETWORK -> owned 2D constraint GROUP -> four owned geometry dependencies -> one LINE target; the eight ordered inline nodes are implicit point, AcFixedConstraint, horizontal constraint, circle, datum line with null dependency handle, bounded line, arc, and AcConstrainedRigidSet with null geometry dependency, reserved flag, identity transform, and geometry-node IDs 2 and 3. The group action list and LINE reactor list each close the four non-null geometry dependencies.

implementation.change: Expanded the existing generated whole-file allocation sweep to eight ordered constraint nodes, adding AcConstrainedRigidSet with its null geometry handle, reserved flag, transform, and geometry-node ID vector. Readback follows the four non-null node references, verifies each dependency owner and LINE target, checks reciprocal action/reactor edges, and checks all eight node payloads. The datum-line and rigid-set nodes retain their admitted null geometry handles.
implementation.method: For ASCII and Binary, warm and calibrate the complete OBJECTS callback, inject std::bad_alloc at each reached offset, require failed publication with byte-identical destination sentinel and unchanged source graph, then retry the same adapter and verify fresh typed readback of root ownership, all eight nodes, four dependencies and reciprocal LINE reactors.

validation.ascii: 88/88 callback allocation offsets injected; destination and source graph preserved; same-adapter retry and typed eight-node graph readback passed.
validation.binary: 86/86 callback allocation offsets injected; destination and source graph preserved; same-adapter retry and typed eight-node graph readback passed.

limitations: Generated transaction and codec-readback evidence only; it does not establish producer prevalence, native constraint solving, or geometry semantics.
Radius/diameter and distance node profiles with value and dimension dependencies remain outside this whole-file transaction vector; direct writer profiles have separate generated wire controls.
